name: Constrict
description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 13) and pulled 5 feet toward the creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, the creature tries to drown it, and the creature can’t constrict another target.
